cards.title: Call Goliad

exchange.speaker: RDO
exchange.text: <callsign>, Goliad landing RWY {to.runway}, <number> in the pattern. <number of solos, or "no solos">.

cards.detail: The RDO reports how many solos are in the pattern, or "no solos".
cards.source: Binder, pp. 14, 30; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 2, slides 12–14.

cards.title: Find the RWY {to.runway} initial
cards.leadIn: Stay outside 5 NM or above 5,000' MSL until set up:
instructions: Initial is 4 NM out on the extended centerline

cards.title: At the 4 NM initial
cards.leadIn: 1,300' MSL · 200 KIAS, offset ¼ WTD to the {to.runway.patternSide} (pattern) side:

exchange.speaker: RDO
exchange.text: <callsign>, you are number <number> for the break, and number <number> when you get here.

exchange.speaker: Pilot
exchange.text: <callsign>, number <number> for the break, number <number> when I get here.

cards.detail: No acknowledgement from the RDO by 2 NM: discontinued entry.
cards.source: Binder, pp. 32–35; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 2, slides 17, 24.
